title: IN MY GARBAGE BIN
text: IN MY GARBAGE BIN. PIECE OF JUNK. GOT SO HOT IT BURNED MY HANDS SO BADLY I HAD TO USE OINTMENT ON THE BURNS. I WOULDN'T TAKE THE TIME TO GO THROUGH ANY LOOPS TO RETURN THIS DANGEROUS PRODUCT, SO I JUST THREW IT INTO MY LARGE TRASH BIN WHICH WILL BE PICKED UP TOMORROW. MY 12 YEAR OLD KRUPS TOASTER IS MORE THAN TWICE THE WEIGHT OF THIS PIECE OF JUNK AND FUNCIONS FAR BETTER. ALL OF THE "SO-CALLED" BLUE LIGHT FEATURES ON THIS "NEW" TOASTER GOT STUCK, THE TOASTER NEVER QUIT HEATING UNTIL I UNPLUGGED IT. I AM BEYOND WORDS HOW ANYONE COULD SELL THIS PROCUCT.

product_metadata.title: KRUPS 2 Slice Toaster with 6 browning levels and 4 easy-to-use functions
features: Extra high-lift lever to avoid burning fingers when removing slices of toast
Extra deep slots for even browning of short and long slices
Removable crumb tray for an easier cleaning process
description: Equipped with enhanced features for outstanding customization, the new KRUPS 2-Slice Toaster gives your breakfast an upgrade, with enough for the whole family. A rotating knob with six browning levels comes together with extra-deep slots, for precise and perfectly even browning results that cover the entire slice. An integrated high-lift lever lets you easily remove your toast or bagel in total safety. Additional features include a 30-second reheat function, a defrost setting and a bagel setting for flawless toasting of bagels. Rounding it all off is a removable rear crumb tray for easy clean-up. This stainless steel toaster is the perfect way to start your day, with a hot, crunchy breakfast toasted to golden-brown perfection.
